# 📖 Reference: `shiplane.yml`

Every key, adapter, module and feature a `shiplane.yml` takes with the first-party plugins
installed. A slot is a name, or `use:` the name with `with:` its options. `shiplane schema` adds
your own adapters for your editor. How to write one: [How-to: YAML config](./how-to-yaml.md).

## Flow

### `flow.sourceControl`

| Name  | What it does                                    | `with`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `git` | Branches, commits and tags, through the git CLI | `main`: The branch releases start from; origin's default branch, main or master, when absent; `format`: Run on the files of a commit before it is made, such as a formatter; `retryDelays`: How long to wait before each new try of a push the network dropped, in ms |

### `flow.codeHost`

| Name     | What it does                                                             | `with`  |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------- |
| `github` | Pull requests, releases and deploy records on GitHub, through the gh CLI | nothing |

### `flow.ciPipeline`

| Name             | What it does                                                | `with`                                                                         |
| ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `github-actions` | Ships through a GitHub Actions workflow, through the gh CLI | `shipWorkflow`: The workflow a ship through CI dispatches: ship.yml by default |

### `flow.versioning`

| Name         | What it does                                                          | `with`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `changesets` | Versions from the changesets in .changeset/, written with each change | `version`: What versions the repository: changeset version by default; `line`: A template for each change's line, with {summary}, {authors} and {pr}; or a ready-made one: whatsChanged, compact; `thanks`: A template for the section that thanks contributors once, with {changes}, {contributors}, {list} and {avatars}; or a ready-made one: sentence, list, avatars, none |
| `commits`    | Versions from conventional commit titles, with no changeset to write  | `line`: A template for each change's line, with {summary}, {authors} and {pr}; or a ready-made one: whatsChanged, compact; `thanks`: A template for the section that thanks contributors once, with {changes}, {contributors}, {list} and {avatars}; or a ready-made one: sentence, list, avatars, none                                                                        |

`flow.approval`: `none` (the default) or `required`.

## Modules

| Name                | What it does                                                                   | `with`                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `backend-service`   | A long-lived service, such as an API: deployed from its tag                    | `name`: What an app's unit file names; the module's kind by default; `serverHosting` (required): The serverHosting adapter: a name, or use: the name with with: its options           |
| `web-app`           | A site served as static files, such as a single-page app                       | `name`: What an app's unit file names; the module's kind by default; `staticHosting` (required): The staticHosting adapter: a name, or use: the name with with: its options           |
| `mobile-app`        | A mobile app: a store build, or an update when its native layer did not change | `name`: What an app's unit file names; the module's kind by default; `mobileDistribution` (required): The mobileDistribution adapter: a name, or use: the name with with: its options |
| `published-package` | A package published to a registry, such as npm                                 | `name`: What an app's unit file names; the module's kind by default; `packageRegistry` (required): The packageRegistry adapter: a name, or use: the name with with: its options       |
| `internal-tool`     | An app nothing deploys: versioned, tagged and noted, nothing more              | `name`: What an app's unit file names; the module's kind by default                                                                                                                   |
| `agent-plugin`      | A plugin for coding agents, such as a Claude Code plugin                       | `name`: What an app's unit file names; the module's kind by default                                                                                                                   |

## Adapters a module ships with

### `serverHosting`

| Name    | What it does                                               | `with`  |
| ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `shell` | Deploys with the shell commands each app's unit file gives | nothing |
| `fly`   | Deploys each app to Fly.io, through flyctl                 | nothing |

### `staticHosting`

| Name               | What it does                                            | `with`  |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `cloudflare-pages` | Deploys each site to Cloudflare Pages, through wrangler | nothing |
| `github-pages`     | Deploys each site to GitHub Pages, through a branch     | nothing |

### `mobileDistribution`

| Name  | What it does                                                        | `with`  |
| ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- |
| `eas` | Builds, submits and updates each app with Expo Application Services | nothing |

### `packageRegistry`

| Name  | What it does                                          | `with`                                                                       |
| ----- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm` | Publishes each package to npm, under its own dist-tag | `staged`: Wait for a person's 2FA approval on npm before a release is public |

## Features

| Name               | What it does                                            | `with`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `release-comments` | Comments on each pull request and issue a ship releases | `apps`: The apps whose ships comment; every app when absent; `codeHost`: The codeHost adapter: a name, or use: the name with with: its options; `sourceControl`: The sourceControl adapter: a name, or use: the name with with: its options |

## Other keys

| Key           | Takes                                                                                                                                                 |
| ------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `units`       | Folders to look in, dir/* or exact. Without it, the workspace file decides.                                                                           |
| `tag`         | How a tag names a version: a format's name, or a format of your own naming {version}. Names: `package`, `plugin`, `single`, `module`.                 |
| `via`         | How a unit ships when both ways can: ci (the flow's CI pipeline) or local (this machine). Names: `ci`, `local`.                                       |
| `display`     | How much the release says while it runs; --verbose and --mascot override.                                                                             |
| `testComment` | The pull request comment of a test version: a preset's name, or a template with {branch}, {commit}, {table} and {install}. Names: `table`, `compact`. |
| `testRelease` | Which channel each branch's test release publishes on: a preset's name, or a map of branch to channel. Names: `nightly`, `prerelease`, `gitflow`.     |
| `prepare`     | A shell command run from the root before each unit ships from this machine; {unit} and {dir} are filled.                                              |

## Example

[`examples/shiplane.yml`](../../packages/shiplane/examples/shiplane.yml) uses five modules and every
first-party plugin; `packages/shiplane-integration/src/__tests__/yamlParity.e2e.test.ts` runs it.
